text:
52세 남성 환자, 급성 hemorrhagic shock으로 입원. 원인은 ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm.

BP 85/50 mmHg, HR 120 bpm, RR 24/min, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 89%.

Severe abdominal pain 호소함.

Norepinephrine 8 mcg/min IV TID 적용함.

High-flow nasal cannula 산소 공급 유지함.

Emergency surgical repair 계획됨.

C-line 적용됨.

Urine output 20 mL/hr 확인됨.

Drowsy 상태 확인됨.

Vascular surgery team notify함.
